name: preview-card-1q
title: Preview Card 1q: Pill on the seam
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The name sits in a pill that straddles the edge between preview and footer.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
